english-display.reason: Ontology v5.2.2: 119 ICD-10-GM codes, apparently the 2026 additions (for example A49.00, R53.0, U53.31), have neither an English nor a German display translation, in the contexts Diagnose and MII_Onkologie_Diagnose. The UI shows them in German only.

torch-output-validation.reason: D13, TORCH 1.1.0: extracted ObservationLab resources fail their profile. When the CRTDL selects the category slice, TORCH replaces the unselected LOINC category coding with a Coding that only carries a data-absent-reason, which lacks the mandatory system and code. When the CRTDL does not select category, identifier or dataAbsentReason, TORCH leaves out the required slices category:observation-category and identifier:analyseBefundCode and drops dataAbsentReason (invariant mii-lab-2). The source data validates.
items: Observation ObservationLab: Constraint failed: mii-lab-2: 'Falls kein Laborwert verfügbar ist, muss eine dataAbsentReason angegeben werden' (defined in https://www.medizininformatik-initiative.de/fhir/core/modul-labor/StructureDefinition/ObservationLab)

dimp-output-validation.reason: Errors the DUP config adds to valid TORCH output. D14, fhir-pseudonymizer 3.1.2: cryptoHash on nodesByType('Reference').reference also hashes url and valueCode of the data-absent-reason extension on _reference, so the Medication gets an extension with a hashed URL. The analyseBefundCode slice is lost because the example DUP config masks all remaining identifiers on purpose.
